documents.title: Punjab Urban Planning and Development Authority (Building) Rules, 1996
documents.jurisdiction_scope: GMADA / PUDA (state-wide unless MC-area byelaws supersede)
documents.notes: CLAUDE.md glossary refers to a 'Building Rules 2021'. The corpus supplied to this build contains the 1996 PUDA Building Rules notification instead -- no 2021 consolidated text or intervening amendments were provided. Do not label this rule_pack '2021'; it is seeded from the 1996 text only. Treat the gap between 1996 and the present as a corpus coverage gap (see REPORT.md), not something to infer.

documents.title: Punjab Regional and Town Planning and Development (General) Rules, 1995
documents.jurisdiction_scope: GMADA / PUDA (state-wide unless MC-area byelaws supersede)
documents.notes: Procedural rules: Board/committee constitution, building completion timelines, appeals and revision procedure. Not a source of numeric setback/coverage/FAR values -- classified reference, not base_rules. May still be cited for procedural findings (e.g. completion-extension deadlines).

documents.title: Punjab New Capital (Periphery) Control Rules, 1959
documents.jurisdiction_scope: GMADA / PUDA (state-wide unless MC-area byelaws supersede)
documents.notes: Periphery control is a GIS/location constraint (per CLAUDE.md glossary), not a drawing-geometry check. Feeds gis/layers + gis/lookup.py as an NOC/permission gate, not the rules engine's pass/fail pack. Classified 'policy' as the closest fit in the doc_type table (drives a remedy/NOC route rather than a direct violation check).

documents.title: Punjab Apartment and Property Regulation Rules, 1995
documents.jurisdiction_scope: GMADA / PUDA (state-wide unless MC-area byelaws supersede)
documents.notes: Governs apartment/plot allotment eligibility and promoter disclosure obligations. Not related to building-dimension compliance. Kept as reference in case an allotment-eligibility ambiguity ever needs a citation; never a basis for a violation finding.

documents.title: Chandigarh Building Rules (Urban) - 2017
documents.jurisdiction_scope: Union Territory, Chandigarh (excludes Abadi Deh of Villages / inhabitations within Lal Dora)
documents.notes: First document ingested for a SECOND jurisdiction/authority (Chandigarh UT), distinct from GMADA/PUDA -- this is a new authority value not present in the frozen BuildingModel.Jurisdiction.authority enum ('GMADA'/'MC_KHARAR'/'MC_ZIRAKPUR'/'UNKNOWN'); extending that enum is a deliberate later step, not done here. Rule 1(ii) of the source states these rules 'come into force from the date of publication in the official gazette' -- the exact gazette publication date is not given verbatim in the text beyond the notification order date (25/7/2017) and a per-page 'Uploaded on 27-07-2017' stamp; version/effective_from use the notification date, not the upload stamp, and this gap should be closed against the actual gazette notification before the rule pack's effective-date logic is trusted. Supersedes the Punjab Capital (Development and Regulation Building) Rules, 1952 (clause 15) -- if that 1952 text is ever ingested too, its rules must be marked effective_to 2017-07-25, never left overlapping. Clause 2(vi): 'Where these rules are silent or ambiguous the provisions of National Building Code/ Model Building Bye Laws-2016 and Chandigarh Master Plan - 2031 shall prevail' -- this makes NBC/MBBL 2016 an incorporated-by-reference fallback for THIS jurisdiction specifically (different from CLAUDE.md's general default that a 'reference' doc can never be the sole basis for a violation) and should inform how that doc_type rule is applied once a rule pack exists for this authority.
